title: Malicious code in brookworker (PyPI)
description: The brookworker package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. These packages do not contain the payload themselves but serve as deceptive loaders to execute code from external URLs. The campaign is identified as having clear malicious intent, such as infostealing.
aiSummary: This threat involves the brookworker PyPI package version 0.1.0, which acts as a loader to download and execute remote malicious scripts. It is part of a coordinated campaign deploying multiple similar packages designed to load malicious code from given URLs. The packages themselves do not contain the payload but facilitate execution of potentially harmful code. The campaign is categorized as malicious with intent to compromise systems, including activities like infostealing.
aiImpact: The impact includes the potential execution of arbitrary malicious code on systems that install and run the brookworker package version 0.1.0. This can lead to unauthorized access, data theft, or other malicious activities depending on the downloaded payload. Since the package downloads and executes remote scripts, it can be used to bypass static detection and deliver various types of malware.
